items.source:
Habitat Restoration - Works Progress and Follow-up

Use this form to record either:
  1. the progress of primary habitat restoration work conducted over a period of months or years within a single work area, or
  2. follow-up (secondary) treatments conducted after primary work has been completed.

It is a companion form to the Combined Site and Work Details survey. The work sites entered in this form must first be entered in the Site and Work Details survey. Site names and locations (polygons) remain consistent between the two forms.

description: Template developed for NSW habitat restoration sector to record the implementation progress of habitat restoration work and/or to details of follow-up site visits to areas where habitat restoration has been undertaken previously. Can be used for similar activities in other jurisdictions.
